'''SAGEducation''' was a division of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order's]] [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|Sub-Adult Group]]. It was responsible for providing education to billions of young beings across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], many on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] which suffered during the break up of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. SAGEducation's successes were the source of a lot of COMPNOR's positive reputation. Dedicated and well-organized, the members of SAGEducation were firm adherents to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] and believed in its future, and that by educating the young of the galaxy they would create better galactic citizens. This view caused confrontation with the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]], which was a source of surprise among the members of SAGEducation.<ref name="ISB">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref>
